text: Can you pull together every site on Marrow Agrisupply you can find across #central-team? List each with where it comes from. Need it before the customer call.
reply_text:

2. Pine Crossing: you posted on 9 Jun 2026 that the morning receiver only sees the afternoon shift on the appointment screen. Hollis said he'd check the shift template and have support test it with the store's login.
3. Maybe Wichita: on 2 Jul 2025 you mentioned an 8am check-in with "the Wichita store dispatcher." Tobias had just said your Zoom room was hosting the Marrow Agrisupply office hours link. But the message never says Wichita is a Marrow store, so please confirm before you use it.
